notes: This cost-matched follow-up was registered only after B2 v3 passed the token-matched automatic gate.
B2 uses domain-specific answer obligations. The collector ranks every query independently and fills top-k round-robin for both variants.
Both variants receive task.question plus decision_context and use the same corpus, top-k, collector policy, price table, fee cap, and three-call allowance.
Automatic gate: both variants complete 10/10 tasks, B2 evidence-obligation recall is at least B1 plus 0.10, and structural citation integrity is 1.0.
Planned human gate: B2 blind obligation coverage is at least B1 plus 0.10, citation support is no worse than B1 minus 0.05, and irrelevant-claim rate is no worse than B1 plus 0.05.
